defects.detail: source is an astrological table of Mercury in the 12 houses ('1. ☿. Unruhig, Unbeständig...'); translation is prose on eyelashes, kohl, glass eyes and a Byzantine amulet (Fig. 231)

reason: translation is of an entirely different text (physiognomy of the eye) with none of the Mercury/house table; wrong page.

defects.detail: 'a very deep Plano convex lens' rendered 'a very thick plano-convex lens' (deep = strongly curved/short-focus)

reason: faithful modernisation of Hooke's description of rowlers, socket-screws, subtense table and 1665 quadrant device; only 'deep' lens as 'thick' is loose.

defects.detail: 'Elysiosque dedit colles habitare' rendered 'gave them the hills of the deep to inhabit' — Elysian dropped
'Cum matura annis illorum tempora cani inficient crines natis' (grey temples at birth) rendered 'when their times are ripe with years and their hair turns gray', losing 'natis'

reason: Hesiod's ages rendered closely (Cadmus, Troy, Tyndaris, iron age, filial impiety); drops 'Elysian' and misses the born-grey sense of 'natis'.

defects.detail: verses 4–7 (नारायणस्तथानन्तो... आ-कार; माधवः... इ-कार; गोविन्दश्च... ई-कार; अमरेशस्तथा... उ-कार) are entirely absent; translation jumps from verse 3 to verse 8
verse 3 (श्रीकण्ठः... अ-कारो) is numbered '|| 7 ||' in the translation
'प्रणवश्च' rendered 'the Sacred Hum'; 'तारकोऽव्ययः' merged into 'Immortal Star'

reason: four of the ten verses (the names for ā, i, ī, u) are missing and verse 3 is misnumbered 7; remaining verses 1–3, 8–10 are broadly right.

defects.detail: critical apparatus and testimonia ('§ 53: (5—7) Sol. 11, 2...'; 'othronos (U 77) J e St Byz...') not rendered
'quarum Teleboides eaedemque Taphiae ab incolis ante Leucadiam appellantur Taphias...' rendered so that 'ante Leucadiam' is lost and Teleboides 'are named Taphias'

reason: Pliny's island list rendered accurately with all names and the 5-mile figure; apparatus omitted and the Teleboides clause slightly garbled.

defects.detail: source is a textless diagram page (faint contour sketches); translation is a Dutch voyage narrative ('summoned the skipper of the captured ship... Samorin... pepper')
entire narrative of Pedralvarez, Correa, Calicut and the pepper-ship raid has no counterpart in the source

reason: source has no text, only a diagram description; translation imports a Portuguese-voyage passage from another page.

defects.detail: gloss for 'Duella... quasi duae sextulae... viii scripulis' says 'two-thirds of an uncia' — two sextulae (8 scruples) is one-third
'ut arte quadam verbo mentis colloquentium quam stilo scribentium' rendered 'through a certain art of words among those who converse, as much as by the stylus' — loose

reason: weights, symbols and both scruple/calculus tables (288…48; 2304…192) match the source; one wrong gloss on duella and a loose rendering of the 'cetera' sentence.

defects.detail: several clauses replaced by '...': 'كما هو المتبادر من الاستغناء', 'فيمكن لاجزاء ان يكون كلامه على وتيرة واحدة', 'يقال كلامه مما يلحق حذفه مضاف وهو اداة التشبيه... مثال المجزوم', 'مع ان هذه المذهب له ولغيره من الكوفيين'
closing glosses 'المنطوق اي المرضي المقوي عليه غيره' and 'لا تزيد بدليل احدى والاربع بل انما افاده في المعنى' absent; examples 'يشعر ويقاتل ويحرك' dropped
'خلافا لظاهر كلام المتن' rendered 'contrary to the apparent text of the manuscript' (متن = the base text)

reason: gist of the commentary on al-Kisāʾī, hamzat al-waṣl and imperative construction is right, but many clauses are elided with ellipses; Arabic grammar read moderately.

defects.detail: final sentence 'The definition of a substance is that which possesses action and qualities and is the inherent cause. 10.' has no counterpart on this page
Hindi aside '( केवल एक रसना इंद्रियसे रसका ग्रहण होता है इत्यादि )' and the Hindi commentary for 8th reason ('आठवां हेतु... जैसे तरुण पदार्थमें') not separately rendered
'न रसाद्य उपदिश्यंते' (tastes are not taught) rendered 'not just the tastes'

reason: reasons 3–9 for the primacy of dravya rendered correctly (merging Sanskrit and Hindi), but a 10th definition is added that the page does not carry.

defects.detail: heavily garbled OCR ('憍信准向十二步及依 二隔憍', '紅非依法是正憍此涌形下作憍衣表') rendered as confident doctrine ('Kaṭhina of Faith', 'Bucket Kaṭhina Boundary', 'Surging Shape')
'唐麦益村' rendered as named villages 'Tangmai and Yicun'; '金寮' as 'Golden Cloister'; numbered 15-item list with '[Missing in original sequence]' imposed on source that does not enumerate so
'自恣棚' rendered 'Pavāraṇā sheds' and repeated '憍' uniformly as Kaṭhina without support

reason: source is a badly corrupted Vinaya-commentary OCR; translation papers over it with fluent invented structure and names; hard to verify, weak confidence.

defects.detail: 'si mihi ex hoc lemate secundus versus occurrerit' (if the second verse comes back to ME) rendered 'if the second verse occurs to you'
'aut amor eius' (my affection for him) rendered 'his love for me'

reason: both Pliny letters (to Nepos, to Falco on Sentius Augurinus) rendered faithfully; slips on 'mihi'→'you' and the sense of 'amor eius'.

defects.detail: whole passage 'Der heilige Bonaventura in itiner. ment. ... schliesset er: Etenim te ipso ... ascendens. Und fahret fort: Si autem quaeras, quomodo haec fiant?' is absent; translation jumps from 'explain hereafter' to 'Ask grace, not instruction'
opening 'Dasjenige zuempfangen' (to receive that which) reduced to 'that which'
column-break fragments 'Sich', 'be-', 'Se-' rendered as 'vis-', 'con-', 'sou-' — not translations of those fragments

reason: drops the Bonaventure/Dionysius introduction and the first Latin sentence, leaving the quoted 'ask grace' passage without its setup; rest faithful.

defects.detail: 'Sein Proceß / unde divina & admirandarum virium quaedam existit Medicina, ist: Daß der Vitriol... durch alle Farben zur höchsten Rubinrothen vnd süssen Essentz erhoben werde' is absent, leaving 'this blood-red sweet extraction' without antecedent
'Besiehe hievon meine beyde Lateinische außgangene Tractatus, vnnd obernante Chemicos' absent

reason: drops the cross-reference and the central process sentence (vitriol raised through all colours to ruby-red sweet essence); remaining sentences accurate.

defects.detail: 'וכל חודש על קדש ומועד שלום' rendered literally 'every month upon the sanctuary and the festival of peace' — likely OCR-garbled phrase rendered word-for-word

reason: close literal rendering of the weeping/prostration rite, the prayer by merit of the patriarchs and the Temple petition; nothing substantive wrong.

defects.detail: 'passe en venules' rendered 'passes in droplets' (venules = veins/streaks)

reason: revivification with Mars, deliquium to metallic salt, and the list of names for philosophical sal ammoniac all = source; reasonable readings of OCR 'lave' (air) and 'noiraur'.
